NA-USA-BERMUDA-BAHAMAS.name: North America: United States, Bermuda and the Bahamas
NA-USA-BERMUDA-BAHAMAS.coverage: The contiguous United States, Alaska including the Aleutian and Pribilof Islands, Hawaii including the Northwestern Hawaiian Islands and Midway, Bermuda, the Bahamas and the Turks and Caicos Islands

NA-MEXICO-CENTRAL.name: North America: Mexico, Central America and the Caribbean
NA-MEXICO-CENTRAL.coverage: Mexico including the Revillagigedo Islands and Clipperton, Guatemala, Belize, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Panama, and the Caribbean from Cuba and the Cayman Islands through Hispaniola, Puerto Rico and the Lesser Antilles

NA-CANADA-WEST.name: North America: Western Canada
NA-CANADA-WEST.coverage: Canada west of 95 degrees west: British Columbia including Haida Gwaii, Alberta, Saskatchewan, western Manitoba, Yukon, the Northwest Territories and western Nunavut, with the western Arctic Archipelago

NA-CANADA-EAST.name: North America: Eastern Canada
NA-CANADA-EAST.coverage: Canada east of 95 degrees west: eastern Manitoba, Ontario, Quebec, the Atlantic provinces including Sable Island, Newfoundland and Labrador, eastern Nunavut and the eastern Arctic Archipelago, with Saint Pierre and Miquelon

SA-WEST.name: South America: West
SA-WEST.coverage: Colombia, Venezuela, Ecuador including the Galapagos Islands, Peru, Bolivia, Chile including Easter Island and the Juan Fernandez Islands, the Guianas, Trinidad and Tobago, Aruba, Curacao and Bonaire, and the Pitcairn Islands

SA-EAST.name: South America: East
SA-EAST.coverage: Brazil including Fernando de Noronha, Argentina, Paraguay, Uruguay, the Falkland Islands, South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

EU-WEST.name: Europe: West
EU-WEST.coverage: Europe west of Russia: the British Isles, Iceland, the Faroe Islands, Scandinavia including Svalbard and Jan Mayen, Finland, the Baltic states, Poland, Belarus, Ukraine, Moldova, Western and Central Europe, Iberia with the Azores, the Mediterranean islands, the Balkans, Greece and European Turkey

EU-EAST.name: Europe: East
EU-EAST.coverage: European Russia west of the Urals, from St Petersburg and the Kola Peninsula to the Volga and the northern Caucasus, including Novaya Zemlya

AF-NORTH.name: Africa: North
AF-NORTH.coverage: North and West Africa: Morocco, Western Sahara, Algeria, Tunisia, Libya, Egypt, Sudan, Chad, the Sahel and the West African coast from Mauritania to Nigeria, with the Canary Islands, Madeira and Cabo Verde

AF-SOUTH.name: Africa: South
AF-SOUTH.coverage: Central, East and Southern Africa from Cameroon, South Sudan, Ethiopia and the Horn of Africa to South Africa, with Madagascar, the Indian Ocean islands including the Seychelles, Mauritius and Reunion, and the South Atlantic islands of St Helena, Ascension, Tristan da Cunha, Gough and Bouvet

AS-INDIA-MIDDLE-EAST-HIMALAYAN.name: Asia: India, the Middle East and the Himalaya
AS-INDIA-MIDDLE-EAST-HIMALAYAN.coverage: The Arabian Peninsula, the Levant, Cyprus, Anatolia, the Caucasus, Iran, Iraq, Central Asia including Kazakhstan, Afghanistan, Pakistan, India, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and the Maldives

AS-CHINA-MONGOLIA.name: Asia: China and Mongolia
AS-CHINA-MONGOLIA.coverage: China including Hainan, Hong Kong and Macau, and Mongolia

AS-RUSSIA-CENTRAL.name: Asia: Central Russia
AS-RUSSIA-CENTRAL.coverage: Siberia from the Urals to Lake Baikal and Transbaikalia, including Franz Josef Land, Severnaya Zemlya and the Taymyr Peninsula

AS-RUSSIA-EAST.name: Asia: Russian Far East
AS-RUSSIA-EAST.coverage: The Russian Far East from Yakutia to the Bering Strait, including Chukotka, Kamchatka, the northern Kuril Islands, Sakhalin, Primorye and Wrangel Island

AS-ASIA-PACIFIC.name: Asia: Japan, Korea and Southeast Asia
AS-ASIA-PACIFIC.coverage: Japan including the Ryukyu and Ogasawara Islands, the southern Kuril Islands, North and South Korea, Taiwan, Myanmar, Thailand, Laos, Cambodia, Vietnam, Malaysia, Singapore, Brunei, Indonesia, Timor-Leste, the Philippines, Palau, Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands

OC-AUSTRALIA-NZ-PACIFIC.name: Oceania: Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific
OC-AUSTRALIA-NZ-PACIFIC.coverage: Australia including Lord Howe, Norfolk and Macquarie Islands, New Zealand including the Chatham, Kermadec and subantarctic islands, Papua New Guinea, Melanesia, Micronesia and Polynesia from the Marshall Islands and Kiribati to Fiji, Samoa, Tonga, the Cook Islands and French Polynesia
